rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something judged generally bad, unsuitable, or unpleasant.

example.english: The food at this restaurant is bad.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 m4 hou2

rows.note: Use 差 when quality, ability, health, condition, appearance, or an experience is poor.

example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 sau2 gei1 jing2 soeng2 hou2 caa1

rows.note: Use 壞 for something intrinsically harmful, evil, broken, spoiled, fake, or for a child who is being naughty.

example.english: Smoking has a bad effect on your health.
example.jyutping: sik6 jin1 deoi3 san1 tai2 jau5 waai6 jing2 hoeng2

rows.note: Use 唔啱 when something is wrong, unsuitable, or inappropriate rather than merely generally bad.

example.english: Your answer is bad—it is incorrect.
example.jyutping: nei5 go3 daap3 on3 m4 ngaam1 wo3
